gemini_free.title: Gemini Free API
gemini_free.api_key_hint: Use a Google AI Studio API Key.
gemini_free.request_path_hint: Base URL, without a model name.
gemini_free.thinking_hint: Lowest automatically uses low when minimal is unsupported.

gemini_free.variables: $text, $from, $to and $detect become source text, source language, target language and detected language.

gemini_free.models_required: At least one model is required.

google_cloud_translate.title: Google Cloud Translation
google_cloud_translate.api_key_hint: The key is sent in the x-goog-api-key header, never in the URL, and stored in Aries's local configuration. Restrict the key to the Cloud Translation API in the Google Cloud console and set a daily quota cap.
google_cloud_translate.billing_hint: Uses Cloud Translation Basic (NMT model). The first 500,000 characters per month are free (a monthly $10 credit shared by Basic and Advanced, not carried over); beyond that, $20 per 1M characters, and billing must be enabled. Source language detection is not billed separately. Unlike the built-in Google Translate, only the translation is returned, without dictionary entries, phonetics, or examples.

azure_translate.title: Azure Translator
azure_translate.key_hint: The key from the Translator resource's "Keys and Endpoint" page in the Azure portal. It is sent in the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header and stored in Aries's local configuration.
azure_translate.region_hint: The resource's region, such as westeurope. Leave it empty for a Global resource.
azure_translate.billing_hint: The free quota applies only to the F0 pricing tier: 2M characters per month (text translation, language detection, dictionary, and transliteration combined), at most 2M characters per hour spread evenly. When it runs out, requests are rejected and nothing is charged. S1 and other tiers are billed from the first character, so check the resource's pricing tier in the Azure portal. Unlike the built-in Bing Translate, this service uses your own resource key.

google_ocr.title: Google OCR
google_ocr.api_key_hint: The key is sent in the x-goog-api-key header, never in the URL, and stored in Aries's local configuration.
google_ocr.billing_hint: The test sends a sample image to Google Cloud Vision once in the current mode and counts toward that mode's quota.
google_ocr.detection_text_detection: General (TEXT_DETECTION) · screenshots, short text, UI text
google_ocr.detection_document_text_detection: Document (DOCUMENT_TEXT_DETECTION) · dense text, articles, scanned pages
google_ocr.detection_type_hint: Each mode has its own 1,000 free units per month; beyond that, $1.50 per 1,000.

azure_ocr.title: Azure OCR
azure_ocr.engine_vision_read: Image OCR (Azure Vision) · F0 5,000 per month
azure_ocr.engine_document_read: Document OCR (Document Intelligence) · F0 500 pages per month
azure_ocr.engine_vision_read_hint: Returns the result in one request; suits screenshots, UI text, and short text. The free tier allows 20 requests per minute. Microsoft has announced that Image Analysis 4.0 retires on 2028-09-25. Requires an Azure Vision (Computer Vision) resource in a region that supports Image Analysis 4.0.
azure_ocr.engine_document_read_hint: Submits the image and polls for the result (usually 1–3 seconds) at a higher resolution; suits dense text, articles, and scanned pages. Requires a Document Intelligence resource.
azure_ocr.endpoint_hint: Each engine needs its own Azure resource. The endpoint and key are on the resource's "Keys and Endpoint" page; add two instances to use both. The key is sent in the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header.
azure_ocr.billing_hint: The free quota applies only to the F0 pricing tier. When it runs out, requests are rejected and nothing is charged; S0 and other tiers are billed from the first call. Free-tier images must be at most 4 MB. The test sends a sample image once with the current engine.

azure_tts.title: Microsoft Azure Speech
azure_tts.key_hint: Stored in Aries's local configuration. Do not share your config file.
azure_tts.endpoint_hint: Leave empty to use the regional endpoint. Enter the endpoint from your Azure Speech resource for a private or custom resource endpoint.
azure_tts.billing_hint: Saving does not synthesize speech. The test sends a short request to Azure. The F0 tier includes 0.5M characters of neural speech per month, after which requests are rejected; S0 is billed from the first character. The free tier lists only standard neural voices; whether HD voices count toward it depends on Microsoft's terms.

openrouter_tts.title: OpenRouter Text-to-Speech
openrouter_tts.api_key_hint: Stored in Aries's local configuration. Do not share your config file.
openrouter_tts.model_hint: Enter an OpenRouter model that supports speech output.
openrouter_tts.voice_placeholder: Leave blank to use the model default
openrouter_tts.voice_hint: Available voices depend on the model. OpenRouter handles the language from the text.
openrouter_tts.billing_hint: Saving does not synthesize speech. A test calls OpenRouter and may incur usage charges.

gemini_tts.title: Gemini Text-to-Speech
gemini_tts.api_key_hint: Stored in Aries's local configuration. Do not share your config file.
gemini_tts.model_hint: Defaults to gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts. For higher quality at lower speed, use gemini-3.8-flash-tts.
gemini_tts.style_hint: For example, speaking slowly. You can also adjust playback speed in the reading window.
gemini_tts.billing_hint: Saving does not synthesize speech. Testing calls the Gemini API and may use free quota or incur charges. Free-tier requests may be used by Google to improve products. Interaction storage is disabled (store: false).

google_cloud_tts.title: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
google_cloud_tts.credential_hint: Stored in Aries's local configuration. API keys use x-goog-api-key; access tokens use Bearer authentication.
google_cloud_tts.request_path_hint: Defaults to the Google Cloud Text-to-Speech v1 endpoint. A compatible custom URL is also supported.
google_cloud_tts.billing_hint: Saving does not synthesize speech. Tests and reading are billed per character, and each family's monthly free quota is shown in its name. Standard and WaveNet, and Neural2 and Polyglot, share a billing SKU, so their free quotas may be counted together. Usage beyond the quota is charged automatically and requires billing to be enabled in Google Cloud.
google_cloud_tts.default_voice_hint: Used for languages without their own voice. Simplified Chinese, English, and Polish use fixed Standard or Chirp 3 HD voices; for other languages, Standard picks the first Standard voice of that language with the chosen gender (the voice list is read once).
google_cloud_tts.voice_by_language_hint: Reading uses the voice set for the detected language. Choose the language, region, voice family, and gender in turn, then pick a voice from the filtered list. Only families with a monthly free quota are listed.
google_cloud_tts.load_voices_hint: Load the voice list to filter step by step. Reading the voice list is not billed per character.
google_cloud_tts.family_standard: Standard · 4M characters free per month (shared with WaveNet)
google_cloud_tts.family_wavenet: WaveNet · 4M characters free per month (shared with Standard)
google_cloud_tts.family_neural2: Neural2 · 1M characters free per month (shared with Polyglot)
google_cloud_tts.family_polyglot: Polyglot (Preview) · 1M characters free per month (shared with Neural2)
google_cloud_tts.family_chirp3_hd: Chirp 3 HD · 1M characters free per month
google_cloud_tts.family_studio: Studio · 1M characters free per month, then $160 per 1M
google_cloud_tts.audio_controls_hint: Chirp 3 HD and Studio voices ignore pitch; speed applies to every family. You can also change the speed with the playback rate in the reading window.
google_cloud_tts.long_text_hint: Long text is split automatically; overlong sentences are split further when needed. Segments are combined into one WAV with full progress and seeking. Please wait until synthesis finishes.

gemini_free.summary: Translation with the Google AI Studio free tier. Create a key and list available free models. Rotation does not increase shared project quotas.

geminipro.summary: Uses the Gemini Developer API. Obtain an AI Studio key and select an available model with a free tier on the official pricing page.

gemini.summary: Gemini speech synthesis uses an AI Studio key. Select a TTS model available on the free tier and a voice. Previews consume quota.

azure.summary: Create separate Translator or Speech resources on F0. Enter the matching resource key and region; follow field hints for custom endpoints.
azure.quota: F0: Translator 2 million characters/month; Speech neural voices 500,000 characters/month. Quotas are separate.

azure_ocr.summary: Vision Read and Document Read use keys and endpoints from their own resources. Select the engine, then enter its resource credentials; choose F0.
azure_ocr.quota: Vision F0: 5,000 transactions/month, 20/minute. Document Intelligence F0: 500 pages/month, first two pages per request.

openai.summary: Connect to official OpenAI or a compatible third-party endpoint. Enter the complete chat/completions URL with a key and model ID from the same provider.

openrouter.summary: OpenRouter speech relay. Create a key and select a model supporting audio output; free text models do not imply free speech models.

deepl.summary: Official API: subscribe to a DeepL API plan, choose API mode, and enter the Auth Key. Keyless mode and DeepLX are separate and may be rate limited.
deepl.quota: Free allowance depends on your current DeepL API plan. Confirm usage and limits in your account; a website subscription is not an API subscription.

baidu.summary: Translation: enable General Translation and enter APP ID and secret. OCR: create the matching Baidu AI application and enter API Key (client_id) and Secret Key (client_secret). Credentials are not interchangeable.
baidu.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

baidu_field.summary: Enable Baidu Domain Translation separately. Enter APP ID and secret, then select an enabled domain. General Translation allowances may not apply.
baidu_field.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

baidu_accurate.summary: Enable the matching Baidu OCR endpoint and create an application. Enter API Key (client_id) and Secret Key (client_secret); check quota for each OCR tier separately.
baidu_accurate.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

baidu_img.summary: Extracts text through Baidu Picture Translation. Enable that API and enter translation APP ID and secret, not OCR client_id/client_secret.
baidu_img.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

tencent.summary: Enable Machine Translation or the matching OCR endpoint. Create SecretId and SecretKey in access management, with permissions and region for that service.
tencent.quota: Tencent Translation stopped issuing new free packages on 2026-10-01; existing packages remain usable until expiry. OCR allowances depend on the endpoint.

tencent_accurate.summary: Enable the matching Tencent OCR endpoint and obtain SecretId and SecretKey from access management. Match region and endpoint to your free package.
tencent_accurate.quota: OCR monthly free packages are grouped by endpoint. Do not assume that high-accuracy OCR and image translation share identical allowances.

tencent_img.summary: Extracts text through Tencent Image Translation. Enable Machine Translation and enter SecretId/SecretKey. It uses translation packages, separate from general OCR allowances.
tencent_img.quota: OCR monthly free packages are grouped by endpoint. Do not assume that high-accuracy OCR and image translation share identical allowances.

alibaba.summary: Enable Alibaba Cloud Machine Translation General Edition. Create a RAM AccessKey restricted to translation, then enter AccessKey ID and Secret.
alibaba.quota: General Edition includes 1 million characters/month. Overage may switch to pay-as-you-go; pricing varies by site. Check billing settings first.

volcengine.summary: Enable Volcengine translation or the matching OCR service. Create a restricted Access Key ID and Secret Access Key, then fill the service form.
volcengine.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

volcengine_multi_lang.summary: Enable Volcengine multilingual OCR separately, then enter Access Key ID and Secret Access Key. General OCR quotas may not apply.
volcengine_multi_lang.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

iflytek.summary: Create an iFlytek application and enable this OCR product separately. Enter APPID, APIKey, and APISecret as requested by the form; fields vary by product.
iflytek.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

iflytek_intsig.summary: Create an iFlytek application and enable this OCR product separately. Enter APPID, APIKey, and APISecret as requested by the form; fields vary by product.
iflytek_intsig.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

iflytek_latex.summary: Create an iFlytek application and enable this OCR product separately. Enter APPID, APIKey, and APISecret as requested by the form; fields vary by product.
iflytek_latex.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

caiyun.summary: Apply for a Lingocloud token on the Caiyun developer platform and enter it in Token. A Lingocloud login account is not an API token.
caiyun.quota: New-user trial: 1 million characters, valid for one month. This is not a recurring monthly allowance; subsequent billing follows current platform rules.

niutrans.summary: Enable the NiuTrans text translation API and enter its API key. Website login credentials are separate from API credentials.
niutrans.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

youdao.summary: Create a Youdao AI application and attach Natural Language Translation. Enter application ID and secret; check allowance expiry and billing settings.
youdao.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

chatglm.summary: Create a BigModel API key and choose a model available to your account. The existing model list is preserved; check the selected model price before use.
chatglm.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

simple_latex.summary: Apply for a UAT token in SimpleTex API management, then enter Token. Confirm your available formula-recognition endpoint and allowance first.
simple_latex.quota: Recurring monthly free quota has not been verified. Check trial duration, allowance, and overage billing in the official console before enabling.

eudic.summary: Sign in to the Eudic OpenAPI authorization page for a token. Enter the wordbook name and token, not your account password.

anki.summary: Install and launch desktop Anki, then install AnkiConnect. The default connection uses local port 8765; allow Aries connection requests.

ollama.summary: Install Ollama and download a local model. Keep its service running and enter the model name and local address. Local mode needs no key; cloud models have separate billing.

system.summary: Local system OCR, without an API key. Language support depends on installed OS recognition language packs.

tesseract.summary: Local Tesseract OCR without an API key. First use may download language data.

qrcode.summary: Recognizes QR codes locally without an API key.

transmart.summary: Keyless Tencent interactive translation; the public endpoint may be rate limited. It is separate from Tencent Cloud Machine Translation.

recommendations.title: Recommended API providers
recommendations.openrouter: One key for models from many providers. Model IDs ending in :free have daily request caps; check the current model page and account limits.
recommendations.chatanywhere: Offers China and overseas endpoints with a daily free allowance. Check the official site for supported models, limits, and connectivity.
recommendations.tuzi: A very low-priced relay provider; compare current model prices on its official pricing page.
recommendations.privacy: Third-party relay: requests pass through its servers. Avoid translating personal information or confidential content.
recommendations.relay_note: Relay providers control their reliability and privacy; Aries cannot guarantee them. Official OpenAI, Google, and Microsoft APIs are alternatives; review their privacy and billing terms.
recommendations.hint: Expand for addresses, allowances and notes

errors.unauthorized_advice: Check that the key is complete, valid, and issued by this endpoint provider.
errors.forbidden: Your account or key lacks permission.
errors.forbidden_advice: Check service activation, model access, and key permissions.
errors.google_cloud_forbidden_advice: Check project billing, API activation, and whether key restrictions allow this API.
errors.azure_forbidden_advice: Match the key, region, and endpoint to one resource of the correct service type.
errors.not_found: Endpoint or model was not found.
errors.not_found_advice: Check the full endpoint and exact model ID; the model may be retired or unavailable to your account.
errors.rate_limit: Request rate or quota limit reached.
errors.rate_limit_advice: Wait, then check per-minute and daily limits in the console. Do not automatically upgrade a free tier to paid.
errors.balance_advice: Check account balance, key spending caps, and billing before changing limits.
errors.region: This service is unavailable in your region.
errors.region_advice: Check supported countries and regions, then select a resource available in your region.
errors.timeout_advice: Check network and proxy settings, shorten the test text, and retry later.
errors.network_advice: Check the endpoint URL, network, proxy, and firewall.
errors.required_advice: Complete the required credentials, endpoint, or model fields.
errors.bad_request_advice: Check the request arguments (JSON) for parameters the provider does not support, or set reasoning effort back to "Model default".
errors.bad_request_arguments_advice: The provider rejected {{param}} in the request arguments (JSON); it is marked below.
errors.bad_request_reasoning_advice: This model does not support the selected reasoning effort; it is marked below.
errors.invalid_json: The request arguments are not valid JSON.
